Dialogue_Text: Can you feel the thrill that was engraved in this place? This is the place where we killed our brother. This is the place where I rushed through your veins, my vessel! I felt it so strongly. We felt so alive.
We had to. We had to feel that way. And we had to win. For the sake of everyone that counted on us.
We had to. We had to feel that way. And we had to win. For the sake of our own survival. It was the key to becoming who we are today.
I remember that day. I felt powerful. I felt strong. I felt amazing.
It was always about more than those others you speak of. Do not lie to your own blood!
Yes. That day made us stronger.
The book you just touched is your story. And we are the ink. I am the ink.
Our story is written in blood, <CHARNAME>, and no matter what you do, it's always going to be that way. No matter if you are the first to raise your blade, you will be the last one to hold it.
Aren't you happy because of it?
I just want to be left alone.
I'm doing this because I am given no other choice!
I'm living the life I was given and... I just got used to it.
You should learn how to enjoy it more. How to be proud of who we are.
Yes. Yes, I can feel that pride. It's in me, too.
Each single day is going to become another page of your story. And the longer you live, the greater the Bloody Pages of Bhaal shall become!
Continue writing your story. Breathe! Feed me! AND LET ME RUSH THROUGH YOUR VEINS!
